meta.what: Ranked self-proposed mutations + pre-registered gates. NOTHING FIRED — proposals wait for human review (acceptance discipline: gate pre-registered, budget capped, ~90% expected rejection is the design).
meta.scoring: score = past_outcome_similarity(refs) x gem_synergy(status-weighted) x falsifiability; KILL-with-validated-diagnostic counts +0.5 (G4); queued duplicates suppressed; queued overlaps penalized 0.8
meta.queue_first: Ledger QUEUED records fire before any proposal: D4 (delta-head ratio / delta-path ternary), G5 (hybrid refiner). D5/G6 are NEW slots beyond the queue.

ranked.mutation: Looped free-delta: one shared transformer block re-entered R=2 (weight-tied) at params matched to the D2/D3 free-delta skeleton — does the −0.029 bpb delta win survive weight sharing?

gate.keep_if: looped-R2 free-delta beats its param-matched non-looped control by >0.005 bpb AND lands within +0.01 bpb of the D3 free-delta arm (the delta advantage survives weight-sharing)
gate.kill_if: looped-R2 loses to its own control by >0.005 bpb, OR gives back the delta advantage (>+0.01 vs the D3 arm at matched params)
gate.inconclusive: between the bands — report both numbers, no verdict inflation
gate.budget: 2 arms x 300s TIME_BUDGET (the D2/D3 speedrun protocol), serialized, GPU-checked
gate.eval: val_bpb on the pinned val shard, paired arms, seed 42 then 1337 on KEEP

ranked.expected_cost: ~2x300s GPU + ~1h build/smoke (loop flag on training/delta_free/train.py); GEMS envelope ~3h GPU
ranked.receipts_drawn: D2 (free-delta KEEP −0.0293), D3 (replication −0.0286 @1337); gem: Looped free-delta (depth-as-loop mine, unfired)
ranked.why_now: The one gem in the pool that is both unfired and rides a hardened KEEP; the composition question (delta x weight-sharing) is open in the literature and cheap to falsify at speedrun budget.

ranked.mutation: Ternary free-delta (full skeleton): BitNet-style BitLinear (ternary {−1,0,+1} weights, absmean scale) on the whole free-delta model — if the delta win survives 1.58-bit weights, that is a multiplier-free LM trained on one 6GB GPU.

gate.keep_if: paired delta (ternary-free-delta minus ternary-baseline, both ternarized, same 300s-class budget) <= −0.01 bpb (the delta win survives ternary weights) AND ternary-free-delta <= fp16-free-delta + 0.05 (ternarization cost bounded)
gate.kill_if: the paired delta advantage inverts under ternary weights (>0), or ternarization costs >0.05 bpb
gate.inconclusive: delta survives but ternary cost lands between +0.02 and +0.05
gate.budget: 2 ternary arms x 300s + quant smoke; overnight-class envelope per GEMS
gate.eval: val_bpb paired; weight-bit receipt per layer

ranked.expected_cost: overnight-class (GEMS: 'overnight'); 4 runs if the 1337 replication clause fires
ranked.receipts_drawn: D2/D3 (the win to survive ternarization); qthe lineage KEEP streak (D14/D19/D20 in the pre-today ledger); gem: Ternary free-delta (SEEDED)

queued_overlap.note: D4 queues ternary weights on the DELTA PATH; this candidate extends ternarization to the whole skeleton. Overlap penalty applied; do not fire before D4's result lands.

ranked.why_now: Biggest-payoff gem in the pool (boat-doctrine endpoint), but it overlaps the queued D4 slot — ranked, gated, and explicitly held until D4 reports.

ranked.mutation: Budget ladder: re-run the D2 paired comparison at TIME_BUDGET=900 (3x) — does the −0.029 bpb paired win grow, hold, or shrink with training? (The WECO L1 'sustained trend' condition, tested on our own mutation.)

gate.keep_if: paired delta @900s <= −0.01 bpb (the free-delta advantage sustains at 3x budget)
gate.kill_if: paired delta @900s >= −0.002 (the win vanishes at scale — it was a short-budget artifact)
gate.inconclusive: between −0.002 and −0.01: shrinking but alive; report the curve
gate.eval: val_bpb paired, seed 42 (1337 clause on KEEP, same as D3)

ranked.expected_cost: ~30 min GPU total (2 x 900s), zero new code (env change only)
ranked.receipts_drawn: D2 (−0.029315 @300s), D3 (−0.028642 @300s/1337); gem: acceptance-gate harness (sustained-trend metrology)
ranked.why_now: Cheapest possible hardening of the fleet's first KEEP, and it manufactures the multi-step-trend evidence an eventual L1 claim needs.

ranked.mutation: Hard-source starved probe: train the G4 diff-masked model on life+mandelbrot frames ONLY (drop the 4 easy sources) at equal budget — does hard-dynamic changed-cell accuracy scale once easy statics stop diluting every batch?

gate.keep_if: changed-cell acc: life >= 39.6% (2x G4's 19.8) OR mandelbrot >= 39.2% (2x G4's 19.6) at the same ~300s budget
gate.kill_if: both < 1.3x G4 (life < 25.7% AND mandelbrot < 25.5%) — hard dynamics are capacity/tokenization-bound, not data-mix-bound, and the diff-target program should pivot to model capacity, not data weighting
gate.inconclusive: one source clears 1.3x but neither clears 2x
gate.budget: 1 x ~300s run (G4_LOSS_MASK=1, corpus flag to the two hard sources); no model changes
gate.eval: changed-cell accuracy per source (the G2/G4 diagnostic axis — the metric the arc actually moves), overall accuracy reported but NOT the gate

ranked.expected_cost: ~5 min GPU + a corpus-subset flag in g1_dataset.py
ranked.receipts_drawn: G4 (diff-mask tripled/quadrupled dynamics — diagnostic validated), G2 (hard dynamics 5.6%/7.5% unchanged), G3 (framerate lever falsified — data-mix is the next lever in the same family)
ranked.why_now: The G1→G4 arc isolated the gradient signal as the bottleneck and fixed it; this tests the remaining dilution hypothesis with one cheap run and a crisp 2x threshold. Direct heir of gem #1 (predict differences, not states).

ranked.mutation: Entropy-reweighted diff loss: keep all 6 sources but weight the loss 4:1 toward high-CE sources' changed cells (life 1.02, mandelbrot 1.96 nats/cell vs smptebars 0.017) — spend the gradient where the entropy is.

gate.keep_if: changed-cell acc: life >= 30% AND mandelbrot >= 28% at full corpus, equal budget
gate.kill_if: neither source beats G4 by >=2 points
gate.eval: changed-cell accuracy per source; CE-per-cell table reported

ranked.expected_cost: ~5 min GPU + a 6-vector in the loss
ranked.receipts_drawn: G4 (mask >> reweight, but same mechanism family), G2 (per-source CE table is the weighting map)
ranked.why_now: The soft version of the starved probe: if reweighting works, production keeps statics (hybrid-refiner-friendly) while still teaching dynamics.

ranked.mutation: Explicit persistence-init conditioning: add the previous frame's code as a second input embedding (canvas-style init made explicit) so the diff head conditions on WHAT changed from, not just where.

gate.keep_if: both hard sources >= 25% changed-cell acc (vs G4's 19.8/19.6)
gate.kill_if: no hard source improves >=1.2x over G4

ranked.expected_cost: ~5 min GPU + ~2h build (input embedding change, smoke required)
ranked.receipts_drawn: G4 (diff-targets work), G1 (persistence is the free statics baseline)

queued_overlap.note: touches the hybrid-refiner territory G5 queues; penalty applied; fire only after G5 reports

ranked.why_now: Canvas-mine probe at glyph scale — 'start from persistence, refine' as an input conditioning rather than a decode loop.
